The Faculty of Health Sciences (FHS) is located at Western University in London, Ontario. Our faculty is committed to bettering the human condition through outstanding training of health professionals, the education of students in the fundamentals of health, disability, and sport, and through the actions of our graduates who integrate the art and science of their disciplines.

With our seven schools, we are one of the broadest interdisciplinary schools in all of Canada:

Brescia School of Food and Nutritional Sciences
Communication Sciences and Disorders
Health Studies
Health & Rehabilitation Sciences (Graduate Program)
Kinesiology
Nursing
Occupational Therapy
Physical Therapy

Innovation is here.
Experience is here.
Opportunity is here.

We are the Faculty of Health Sciences.
Welcome home.
